name: SBB
author: vvkycodevv
description: Next Swiss train in the Omarchy bar, a live departure board, and route search. Data from transport.opendata.ch.

barWidget.description: Next departure from your home station or along a chosen route, with a departures board and route search in the panel.

schema.label: Home station
schema.description: Station shown on the departure board and followed by the bar. Also the start of a route that names only a destination.

schema.label: Bar follows
schema.description: Home station: every train leaving it. Route: the next connections from start to destination (set in barRoute), on the bar and the board.

schema.label: Followed route
schema.description: From > To, e.g. Bern > Thun. Just Thun starts at the home station. Used when the bar follows a route.

schema.label: Only trains towards
schema.description: Optional. The bar shows the next train from the home station that stops here, e.g. Luzern. Not used when following a route.

schema.label: Show in bar
schema.description: Next departure (home station or followed route) in the bar. Off: only the train icon.

schema.label: Colours
schema.description: Figma: the Tokyo Night pill and panel from the design. Theme: follow the active Omarchy theme.

schema.label: Route search results
schema.description: Connections listed per route search, including favourite routes.

schema.label: Notify when late by (minutes)
schema.description: 0 turns notifications off. Cancellations are always reported when this is on.

schema.label: Favourite routes
schema.description: From > To, separated by semicolons, e.g. Bern > Thun. Numbered 1 to 9: ctrl 1-9 in the route search, and a global shortcut each (see favouriteShortcut). Add the current route with ctrl s.

schema.label: Keyboard shortcuts
schema.description: Register global shortcuts for the board, the route search and favourites. Keys already in use are skipped.

schema.label: Board shortcut
schema.description: Toggles the departures board. Empty turns it off.

schema.label: Route search shortcut
schema.description: Toggles the route search. Empty turns it off.

schema.label: Favourite shortcut modifiers
schema.description: Modifiers for favourites 1 to 9, e.g. SUPER + CTRL + ALT gives super+ctrl+alt+1. Empty turns them off.
